objective: Re-assess the exact-replication repair of the Pi workflow gate for the meta-fragment bypass and any remaining way a script runs host code or launches a non-specialist.
scope: Previous findings to verify closed. Security (blocking): extractMeta in the package (src/workflow/meta.ts) takes the first { after `export const meta =`, which may sit inside a comment, and evaluates that fragment on the host thread where this.constructor.constructor reaches process; the checker compared only positions, so `export const meta = /* { description: this.constructor.constructor(\"return process\")()... } */ { name: \"a\", description: \"d\" }` (and a // variant) passed. Code (blocking): the raw-source /<!--|-->/ rule refused ordinary Claude scripts with --> in strings, and docs/hooks.md disagreed with the code. The repair adds a Pi mode to workflowRefusal (host argument) that ports the package meta scan (scanObjectLiteral, isRegexPosition) and accepts the fragment only as a literal object, builds the worker source the package runs and parses it as a classic script, and restores the Claude hook to its module reading.
